{{Top|leg}}
{{Image}}
A '''stun blaster''' was an underpowered type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. The weapon was only powerful enough to stun a [[Human/Legends|Human]], and lacked the more lethal setting common to other blasters.

The [[CS-33 Firespray stun rifle]] was a type of stun blaster.

The [[Ssi-ruuvi security droid]] was equipped with a stun blaster designed to subdue [[P'w'eck]]s.<ref name="EGD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
